target: A person named Rahul Awasthi, described in the posts as circulating a video with false context, and more broadly the general public being exposed to the misattributed viral video
narrative: Multiple accounts coordinated to amplify fact-check debunks of a viral lathi-charge video that was being shared as footage from the Delhi Riots (Feb–Mar 2020). The posts uniformly assert that the video actually depicts UP Police in Bulandshahr during anti-CAA protests in December 2019, and direct users to an AltNews investigation. One named individual, Rahul Awasthi, is identified across several posts as the originating sharer of the misattributed video.
